title: Set 45

sentences.ko: 우리 층에 뭐만 했다 하면 우리 부장님을 참조로 넣는 여자가 있어요. 파일 어디 있냐고 물어볼 때도 그래요. 나쁜 뜻으로 그러는 게 아닌 건 아는데, 이제 저는 메시지 보내기 전에 네 번씩 읽어 봐요.
sentences.text: There's this woman on my floor who cc's my boss on everything, even when she's just asking where a file is, and I know she doesn't mean anything by it, but now I read every message four times before I send it.

alts.text: Someone on my floor cc's my boss on everything, even when she's just asking where a file is, and I don't think she means anything by it, but now I'm reading every message four times before I hit send.

There is a woman on my floor who copies my manager on every message, even when she is simply asking where a file is. I know she does not mean anything by it, but I now read every message four times before I send it.

sentences.note: **cc's my boss on everything** 은 무슨 일이든 상사를 참조로 넣는다는 뜻입니다. **doesn't mean anything by it** 은 나쁜 뜻으로 그러는 건 아니라는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 배송 완료라고 뜨고 사진까지 찍어 놨는데, 사진에 있는 저 문은 우리 집 문이 아니에요. 옆 건물이에요. 그럼 모르는 사람 집에 가서 문을 두드려야 하나요, 아니면 그건 좀 이상한가요?
sentences.text: It says delivered and they even left a photo, but that's not my door in the picture, that's the building next to mine. So do I go knock on some stranger's door, or is that weird?

alts.text: Tracking says delivered, and there's a photo and everything, but that's not my door in it, that's the building next to mine. So am I supposed to knock on some stranger's door, or is that weird?

The tracking says it was delivered, and a photograph was even provided, but the door in the photograph is not mine. It is the building next to mine. Should I go and knock on a stranger's door, or would that be inappropriate?

sentences.note: **It says delivered** 는 배송 완료로 떴다는 뜻입니다. **is that weird?** 는 이렇게 해도 이상한가 하고 되물을 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 폰 자체는 멀쩡한데 구석에 긁힌 자국이 하나 있어요. 화면 꺼져 있을 때만 겨우 보이는 정도예요. 여기까지 다 오셔서 보고 기분 상하시는 것보다 지금 말씀드리는 게 나을 것 같아서요. 그러면 10달러 깎아 드릴게요.
sentences.text: The phone works fine, but there's a scratch down in the corner that you really only see when the screen's off, and I'd rather tell you now than have you drive all the way out here and be annoyed about it. I can come down ten bucks if that helps.

alts.text: So the phone itself is fine, but there's a scratch down in the corner you can really only see when the screen's off, and I'd rather say it now than have you drive all the way out here and be annoyed about it. I can knock ten bucks off if that helps.

The phone works perfectly, but there is a scratch in the corner that is really only visible when the screen is off, and I would rather tell you now than have you drive all the way out here and be annoyed about it. I can reduce the price by ten dollars if that would help.

sentences.note: **I'd rather tell you now than** 은 나중에 어떻게 되느니 차라리 지금 말하겠다는 뜻입니다. **come down ten bucks** 는 10달러 깎아 준다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 동생이 또 돈을 빌려 달래요. 큰돈은 아니고, 지난번에도 갚기는 갚았어요, 한참 걸리긴 했지만. 근데 빌려주면 한 달 내내 짜증날 거고, 안 빌려주면 한 달 내내 마음이 불편할 거예요. 그래서 둘 중에 어느 쪽 얘기를 듣고 싶으세요?
sentences.text: My brother asked me for money again, and it's not a lot, and he did pay me back last time, eventually. But if I say yes I'm going to be annoyed about it for a month, and if I say no I'm going to feel awful about it for a month. So which one of those do you want to hear about?

alts.text: So my brother's asking me for money again. It's not much, and okay, he did pay me back last time, eventually. But if I say yes I'm gonna be annoyed about it for a month, and if I say no I'm gonna feel awful about it for a month. So which one do you wanna hear about?

My brother has asked me for money again. It is not a large amount, and he did repay me last time, eventually. However, if I agree I will be annoyed about it for a month, and if I refuse I will feel awful about it for a month. So which of the two would you prefer to hear about?

sentences.note: **he did pay me back** 의 did 는 갚기는 갚았다고 인정할 때 붙입니다. **eventually** 는 한참 걸려서 결국이라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 늦잠 잤어요, 그것도 아주 심하게. 근데 저 안에 들어가서 그 말을 할 생각은 없으니까, 누가 물어보면 고속도로에서 사고 때문에 막혔다고 해 주세요. 지난주에 실제로 사고가 나긴 했으니까 거짓말이랄 것도 없죠.
sentences.text: I overslept, like really badly, and I'm not saying that out loud in there, so if anybody asks I got stuck behind an accident on the highway. There actually was one last week, so it's barely even a lie.

alts.text: I slept through my alarm, like really badly, and I'm not saying that out loud in there, so if anybody asks, I got stuck behind a crash on the highway. There actually was one last week, so it's barely even a lie.

I overslept, quite badly, and I do not intend to say that out loud in there, so if anyone asks, I was held up behind an accident on the highway. There genuinely was one last week, so it is barely even a lie.

sentences.note: **got stuck behind an accident** 는 앞에 난 사고 때문에 길에 갇혔다는 뜻입니다. **it's barely even a lie** 는 거짓말이라고 하기도 뭐하다는 말입니다.

reviewed: 1번 formal 이 "I know she doesn't mean anything by it" 을 "I am sure..." 로 바꿔 확신의 결이 달라져서, 말투만 올리고 뜻은 그대로 두게 "I know she does not mean anything by it" 으로 되돌렸습니다.
2번 한국어 뒷부분이 "문을 두드리러 가야 하나요" 라 옮긴 티가 나서 "모르는 사람 집에 가서 문을 두드려야 하나요" 로 고쳤습니다.
3번 한국어의 "그게 도움이 되면" 은 if that helps 를 그대로 옮긴 번역투라 "그러면" 으로 바꿨습니다.
